act: Aguada, Vice Parroquia de Ntra. Sra. del Carmen
the act says: *** 21 November 1852 ***, born *** 16 March 1852 ***, 'a las once y media del dia'
child: *** PEDRO ALBERTO YSABELINO LERENA *** (the ALBERTO of the family)
godparents: *** PEDRO ANT.o LERENA y VICENTA VEGA *** - his own uncle and aunt

index says: not separately indexed on this opening
the act says: baptised in *** mil ochocientos cincuenta y dos ***; born 'el diez de Febrero del ano proximo pasado'
child: *** JOSEFINA (JOSEFA) LERENA ***, later Josefa Lerena Traibel (1851-1947)
godparents: Dn. Miguel Carlos Correa de Lemus and Josefa Corbelle de Lemus; priest *** Domingo Ereno ***
